crossRefs.note: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.
Have mercy on me, Yahweh. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,
Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.
Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.
Yahweh said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of…
I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good and…
Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness, don’t let…
“Look, Yahweh, and see to whom you have done thus! Should the women eat their offspring, the children that they held…
Remember, Yahweh, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.
I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.
Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.
My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.
I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.
I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.

translations.web: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.
translations.bsb: Look upon my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your law.
translations.kjv: RESH. Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
translations.asv: RESH. Consider mine affliction, and deliver me; For I do not forget thy law.
